title: Remote Control Mirrors with Heater - Wiring Diagram

content.description: Wiring diagram showing Trip Computer connection on the left side with connections labeled F, S, J (numbered 7, 8, 9) and notes about 'For Vehicles With 5M-GE', 'For Vehicles With 5M-GE without Remote Control Mirrors', and 'For Vehicles With 7M-GE'

Wiring diagram showing Remote Control Mirror system with heater connections. Includes power relay connections from defogger relay (2-B), fuse connections (10A HTR and 10A CD), REMOTE CONTROL MIRROR S/W switch matrix with UP/DOWN/RIGHT/LEFT controls for both RH and LH positions, and mirror motor connections for both left and right mirrors (MIRROR MOTORS LH and MIRROR MOTORS RH). The switch matrix shows detailed connection points labeled B, E, LH, V1, C, V2, S2 with multiple connection terminals.

content.caption: REMOTE CONTROL MIRROR S/W
content.description: Switch connection matrix showing positions for RH (UP, DOWN, RIGHT, LEFT) and LH (UP, DOWN, RIGHT, LEFT) controls with corresponding terminal connections across columns B, E, LH, V1, C, V2, S2
